DIRECTORIES

The exact location of configuration files depends on the distribution. It is recommended to use the configuration files in /etc/systemd/system/, /run/systemd/system/, and /usr/lib/systemd/system/. /etc/systemd/system/ has the highest priority, /run/systemd/system/ has the second highest priority, and /usr/lib/systemd/system/ has the lowest priority.

A running system may have a runtime configuration root in /run/systemd/.

Configuration snippets for individual units may be placed in subdirectories ending in .d, e.g. /etc/systemd/system/foo.service.d/. These snippets are read in alphabetically sorted order. See systemd.unit(5) for details.
